## What is CanHealth 2024?

CanHealth 2024 is a **fictitious** national health survey created to demonstrate
the Quarto + DuckDB + Plotly data portal framework. It simulates the structure
of real population health surveys such as the Canadian Community Health Survey (CCHS).

::: {.stat-callout}
**Portal last generated:** `{python} manifest['generated_at'][:10]`  
**Respondents:** `{python} f"{manifest['n_respondents']:,}"`  
**Aggregated output files:** `{python} len(manifest['files'])`
:::

---

## Survey design

| Feature | Detail |
|---|---|
| **Survey name** | CanHealth 2024 (Fictitious) |
| **Reference population** | Canadian residents aged 18 and older |
| **Sample size** | 5,000 synthetic respondents |
| **Sampling design** | Simulated stratified by province and age |
| **Survey weight** | Post-stratification weight (mean ≈ 1.0, log-normal noise) |
| **Data collection mode** | Simulated — see `scripts/generate_data.py` |
| **Microdata format** | Apache Parquet (columnar, compressed) |

## Sample distribution by province

```{python}
#| echo: false
access = load("healthcare_access")
prov_df = pd.DataFrame(access["by_province"]).sort_values("n", ascending=True)

fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(
    x=prov_df["n"],
    y=prov_df["province"],
    orientation="h",
    marker_color=COLORS["primary"],
    text=prov_df["n"],
    textposition="outside",
    hovertemplate="%{y}: %{x} respondents<extra></extra>",
))
fig.update_layout(xaxis_title="Number of respondents", yaxis_title="")
fig_defaults(fig, "Sample Size by Province / Territory", height=430).show()
```

## Variables collected

```{python}
#| echo: false
codebook_path = Path("data/raw/codebook.json")
if codebook_path.exists():
    codebook = json.loads(codebook_path.read_text())
    rows = [
        f"| `{var}` | {desc} |"
        for var, desc in codebook["variables"].items()
    ]
    table_md = "| Variable | Description |\n|---|---|\n" + "\n".join(rows)
    from IPython.display import Markdown, display
    display(Markdown(table_md))
else:
    print("Codebook not found — run scripts/generate_data.py first.")
```

## How the portal works

This portal is built on three stages that are **completely separated from each other**:

```
┌─────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 1: Generate data │  scripts/generate_data.py
│  (run once locally)     │  → data/raw/microdata.parquet
└────────────┬────────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 2: Tabulate      │  scripts/tabulate.py
│  (run locally before    │  → data/aggregated/*.json
│   every publish)        │
└────────────┬────────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 3: Quarto render │  quarto render  OR
│  (pure static HTML;     │  quarto publish gh-pages
│   reads only JSON)      │
└─────────────────────────┘
```

**Key privacy property:** Only the aggregated JSON files travel to GitHub.
The raw `data/raw/` folder is listed in `.gitignore` and is never committed.

---

::: {.data-note}
All data in this portal are **entirely synthetic**. No real Canadians or health records
are represented. The survey instrument and findings are illustrative only.
:::
